changes.title: UIMSD prepares its fully usable Home before the title-menu tap
changes.text: While the title is visible and UIMSD is permitted, a low-priority daemon prepares the exact saved layouts, cryptographically validated history catalog and initial Home statistics. Tapping claims only a fully READY exact-match model; changed history, rules or scope falls back to the unchanged authoritative loader.

changes.title: Warm-cache identity, invalidation and title wiring are guarded
changes.text: Three permanent cache tests cover READY single-owner handoff, changed raw-history rejection and rule/scope mismatch. The title guard positively checks the approved hook placement while retaining the prior responsive-layout checksum. Full core run 40701500539 passed 2100 methods across 408 suites.

changes.title: Android acceptance follows the approved in-place Settings behavior
changes.text: The native restoration suite no longer waits for an ordinary Settings close to rebuild UIMSD; it requires the same scene and no stale window. The realistic 72-run timing fixture separately records background preparation and requires a READY tap-time handoff under one second without waiting, with single-use ownership.
